```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(GSVA)
library(msigdbr)   
library(dplyr)
library(biomaRt)
library(tibble)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r Load Counts}
counts <- read.csv("/Volumes/yerkes/genomelab/illumina/runs/Analysis_BLab/Sydney/GSVA for Mirko/raw_count_p24027_Tomas_Analysis.csv", row.names = 1)
```

```{r Normalize Counts with DESeq2}
#convert counts to dataframe 
cd <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(counts))
#Create DESeq2 object
dds_GSVA <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(counts, cd, design = ~1)
#Remove genes with low counts
dds_GSVA <- dds_GSVA[rowSums(counts(dds_GSVA) >= 10) >= 2, ]
#Estimate size factors
dds_GSVA <- estimateSizeFactors(dds_GSVA)
#Normalize
vsd_GSVA <- vst(dds_GSVA, blind = TRUE)
#Create matrix for GSVA
expr_for_gsva <- assay(vsd_GSVA)
```

```{r Map Ensembl IDs to gene symbols if available}
# Separate rows into Ensembl IDs vs. other gene symbols
ensembl_rows <- grepl("^ENSMMUG", rownames(expr_for_gsva))
ensembl_ids <- rownames(expr_for_gsva)[ensembl_rows]
other_symbols <- rownames(expr_for_gsva)[!ensembl_rows]

# Connect to Ensembl
ensembl_macaque <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "mmulatta_gene_ensembl")
ensembl_human   <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

# Map Ensembl macaque IDs to human symbols
ensembl_map <- getBM(
  attributes = c("ensembl_gene_id", "hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name"),
  filters = "ensembl_gene_id",
  values = ensembl_ids,
  mart = ensembl_macaque
)

# Create a mapping vector (default to original ID if no human ortholog found)
human_symbols <- setNames(ensembl_map$hsapiens_homolog_associated_gene_name,
                          ensembl_map$ensembl_gene_id)

# Replace Ensembl IDs with human symbols, keep unmapped IDs as original
new_rownames <- sapply(rownames(expr_for_gsva), function(x) {
  if (x %in% names(human_symbols)) {
    human_symbols[[x]]
  } else {
    x
  }
})

rownames(expr_for_gsva) <- new_rownames
head(expr_for_gsva)

# Collapse duplicated gene symbols by averaging
expr_for_gsva <- expr_for_gsva %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(rownames(expr_for_gsva)) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), mean)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "rownames(expr_for_gsva)")

# Remove rows with blank or missing rownames
expr_for_gsva <- expr_for_gsva[rownames(expr_for_gsva) != "" & !is.na(rownames(expr_for_gsva)), ]

# Make sure it's a numeric matrix
expr_mat <- as.matrix(expr_for_gsva)
```

```{r GSVA analysis - Hallmark gene set}
#Load hallmark gene sets from MSigDB
m_df_hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")

# Convert to list format
gene_sets_hallmark <- split(x = m_df_hallmark$gene_symbol, f = m_df_hallmark$gs_name)

#Run GSVA
gsva_res_hallmark <- gsva(gsvaParam(expr_mat, gene_sets_hallmark))

#save results
write.csv(x = gsva_res_hallmark, file = "results/gsva_res_hallmark.csv")
```

```{r GSVA Analysis - GOBP gene set}
#Load GOBP gene set
m_df_gobp <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP")

# Convert to list format
gene_sets_gobp <- split(x = m_df_gobp$gene_symbol, f = m_df_gobp$gs_name)

#Run GSVA
gsva_res_gobp <- gsva(gsvaParam(expr_mat, gene_sets_gobp))

#save results
write.csv(x = gsva_res_gobp, file = "results/gsva_res_GOBP.csv")
```

```{r GSVA Analysis - Reactome gene set}

m_df_reactome <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2", subcategory = "REACTOME")

# Convert to list format
```
